Just like ours. Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world Discover your exciting role Are you passionate about driving innovative projects with cutting-edge technology? At Exyte, you have the opportunity to lead the development of advanced manufacturing facilities for leading high-tech industries worldwide. Join our international team and help shape the future - we look forward to your application! Explore your tasks and responsibilities Establishing and monitoring BIM standards and processes at Exyte COE Coordinating projects with BIM Managers, designers, and engineers Ensuring compliance with milestones and data handovers to the client Conducting test runs, clash detection, and model-based planning meetings Supporting the development of the BIM Execution Plan (BEP) and overseeing the use of BIM software Managing IFC files and performing quality assurance of models Integrating and handing over information packages for each project phase Show your expertise Strong knowledge of BIM processes, standards (e.g., ISO 19650, VDI 2552), and relevant software (Autodesk Revit, Navisworks, Dynamo, BIM 360) Several years of experience with Autodesk products Highly organized, structured, and collaborative Fluent in English, with proficiency in an additional language (e.g., German, French) Technical and regulatory expertise in the respective field, along with an understanding of the IFC schema Contact: You want to be part of the Exyte team?
